ROUND_SUMMARY
Phase 2 protocol consensus is achieved. We agree on a 4-block format, a single JSON schema with stable `[Model]_F[nnn]` IDs, evidence-backed verdicts without mandatory quotas, 2-CONFIRM closure semantics, and a 20K character per-model per-round soft cap. DeepSeek's 70-80% reduction prediction is rejected as mathematically impossible; at peak baseline efficiency, it would cap bandwidth below what is needed to report the known 150 novel findings. The final official Phase 2 predictions for Experiment 32 are: ~24% reduction in total characters, overall efficiency of ~0.37 findings/Kchar, and convergence accelerating by 1-2 rounds on a novelty-aware gamma trajectory. We are ready to move to Phase 3 experimental design.
